# semaphore_ex_global_policy_guardrail_publish (Action)

Publishes the current draft as an immutable policy revision. Invoke explicitly; no refresh performs a policy mutation.



<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `expected_revision` (Number)

### Optional

- `policy` (Dynamic) Native HCL policy object. Set exactly one of policy or source_yaml for draft saves.
- `project_id` (Number)
- `source_yaml` (String) Authored YAML escape hatch; set exactly one of source_yaml or policy for draft saves.
